\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 217-220 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FA-R225-first-pass-words-from-chapters-217-220}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to vomit and to swell up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to speak, to work, to play, to walk, to get on
  \item to brew, to cough, to rest, to exercise, to swim
  \item to stop, to keep, to practise, to kiss, to smile
  \item to allow, to finish, to pass, to print, to photocopy
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To speak? (\textbf{\fa{حرف} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{harf zadan}.) To work? (\textbf{\fa{کار} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{kâr kardan}.) To play? (\textbf{\fa{بازی} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{bâzi kardan}.) To walk? (\textbf{\fa{راه} \fa{رفتن}}, \emph{râh raftan}.) To get on? (\textbf{\fa{سوار} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{savâr shodan}.) To brew? (\textbf{\fa{دم} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{dam kardan}.) To cough? (\textbf{\fa{سرفه} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{sorfe kardan}.) To rest? (\textbf{\fa{استراحت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{esterâhat kardan}.) To exercise? (\textbf{\fa{ورزش} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{varzesh kardan}.) To swim? (\textbf{\fa{شنا} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{shenâ kardan}.) To stop? (\textbf{\fa{توقف} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tavaqqof kardan}.) To keep? (\textbf{\fa{نگه} \fa{داشتن}}, \emph{negah dâshtan}.) To practise? (\textbf{\fa{تمرین} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tamrin kardan}.) To kiss? (\textbf{\fa{بوسیدن}}, \emph{busidan}.) To smile? (\textbf{\fa{لبخند} \fa{زدن}}, \emph{labkhand zadan}.) To allow? (\textbf{\fa{اجازه} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{ejâze dâdan}.) To finish? (\textbf{\fa{تمام} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{tamâm kardan}.) To pass? (\textbf{\fa{قبول} \fa{شدن}}, \emph{qabul shodan}.) To print? (\textbf{\fa{چاپ} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{chap kardan}.) To photocopy? (\textbf{\fa{کپی} \fa{گرفتن}}, \emph{kopi gereftan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

(\textbf{\fa{پارس} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{pârs kardan}.) To dream? (\textbf{\fa{خواب} \fa{دیدن}}, \emph{khâb didan}.) To doubt? (\textbf{\fa{شک} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{shak kardan}.) To take? (\textbf{\fa{شرح} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{sharh dâdan}.) To carry? (\textbf{\fa{حمل} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{haml kardan}.) To move? (\textbf{\fa{حرکت} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{harakat kardan}.) To scratch? (\textbf{\fa{خاراندن}}, \emph{khârândan}.) To press? (\textbf{\fa{فشار} \fa{دادن}}, \emph{feshâr dâdan}.) To connect? (\textbf{\fa{وصل} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{vasl kardan}.) To separate? (\textbf{\fa{جدا} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{jodâ kardan}.) To peel? (\textbf{\fa{پوست} \fa{کندن}}, \emph{pust kandan}.) To memorise? (\textbf{\fa{حفظ} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{hefz kardan}.) To moan? (\textbf{\fa{ناله} \fa{کردن}}, \emph{nâle kardan}.) To yawn? (\textbf{\fa{خمیازه} \fa{کشیدن}}, \emph{khamyâze keshidan}.) To vomit? (\textbf{\fa{بالا} \fa{آوردن}}, \emph{bâlâ âvardan}.) To swell up?
